user.title: Circadian Scenes
user.description: Adds Circadian Scenes to the sidebar. Create and edit rooms from there — one integration, as many areas as you need. Daylight that follows the sun between your scenes.

empty.extrapolation: No circadian scenes yet. Create one to start lighting a room from the sun.
empty.created: No native scenes created by Circadian Scenes yet. They appear here when you use Automatic setup or Create new scene.

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: These settings apply to every room. Changes take effect immediately.
settings.hide_created: Hide created scenes in Home Assistant
settings.hide_created_helper: Marks native scenes created by this integration as hidden in the HA UI (entity registry). You can still manage them here.
settings.automatically_update_lights_interval_hel: After a scene is activated, keep updating the lights this often with the same transition length (target = how the room should look at the end of the transition). 0 turns automatic updates off for every room. Pause individual rooms from the list.

draft.title: Picked up where you left off
draft.detail: Unsaved changes from a previous session are restored.

location.no_matches: No matching places. Try a city name or move the map.

dialogs.unsaved_text: You have unsaved changes. Discard them?
